title: ecology
description: The relating of organisms into a multi-agent system: organisms interacting with one another and their environment through energy flow, nutrient cycling, and community dynamics. The society-of-agents reading of life. Generated by the organism's relating.

organisms.description: a community of interacting living agents

environment.description: the abiotic context the community relates to
